patch_definitions.name: The Real TB303
patch_definitions.description:
Sawtooth TB-303 bass with Accent and Slide implemented via midi note velocity.
Velocity selects flags only; there is no continuous velocity gain. 
- MIDI velocity 1-63: normal
-  64-95: slide
- 96-111: accent
- 112-127: accent + slide. 
Accent changes iamp from 0.4 to 0.9 and filter-envelope amount from 0.4 to 0.8.
MIDI controllers: CC10: cutoff 40-16000 Hz, logarithmic (49 approximately 404 Hz). CC11: resonance 0-0.98 (114 approximately 0.88). Both controllers follow the played MIDI channel and use 10 ms smoothing.
Performance controller iamp / Drive: 0.1-32x, logarithmic, default 1x. Multiplies the original accent-dependent iamp before tanh; new notes read the performance knob.
Slide: portk half-time 60 ms versus 1 ms for regular notes, retaining the prior voice state. For reliable previous-note glide use a single-note line, begin with a non-slide note, and leave at least 50 ms after note-off for voice reuse; overlapping/release-tail voices do not share pitch history. This is the native portk implementation, not a legato note-priority engine.
Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.
Drive output compensation: post-tanh gain (1 + 0.025 * drive) / (1.025 * drive). The 1x sound is unchanged; higher Drive primarily adds distortion with only a small level increase (approximately +1.4 dB RMS at 32x in the reference phrase). This is a fixed compensation curve, not a loudness limiter; level response varies with notes and filter settings.

patch_definitions.name: Analog Drumkit
patch_definitions.description: Five velocity-sensitive analog synthesis voices selected by MIDI notnum through Switch. MIDI notenum 35: Bass drum (pitch-swept sine + click); 36: Bass drum distorted (saturated sine + click); 46: Hi-hat open (700 ms); 42: Hi-hat closed (85 ms); 38: Snare (two sine resonances + filtered noise). Hats use six inharmonic square oscillators plus noise. One-shot decays survive short MIDI note-offs. Silent default; stereo output; no samples. GM bass-drum slot 36 is used for the distorted variation.

patch_definitions.name: Chakra Vowel Talker
patch_definitions.description: Talking pulse voice with two animated formant bands, a little fundamental, filtered dotted-eighth repeats and a chamber tail. MIDI 43–76. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.
